title: Bounded Review Closure
description: Adds scope-locked acceptance contracts, delta verification, blocker thresholds, and deterministic review closure.

requirements.text: Approved scopes define stable acceptance criteria and a scope lock.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow and prompts require AC IDs, finding IDs, exact file scope, exclusions, and gates before implementation.

requirements.text: Only evidenced high-impact conditions enter merge blockers.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol and machine contract enumerate the exact blocker bases and non-blocking classes.

requirements.text: Post-implementation review defaults to delta mode.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts prohibit unconstrained full re-review after implementation or correction except documented reopen conditions.

requirements.text: Finding lifecycle and correction rounds are bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Closed findings need new evidence to reopen and only one normal correction round is allowed.

requirements.text: Review output separates blockers, backlog, and observations and stops at MERGE_READY.
acceptance_criteria: All three queues and all closure verdicts are normative and the stop rule is machine validated.

requirements.text: The closure contract is machine-readable and dependency-free validated.
acceptance_criteria: JSON contract, JSON Schema, validator, and mutation tests agree.

requirements.text: Archive and patch-pack prompts preserve the approved contract without scope creep.
acceptance_criteria: Review, review-only, archive guide, root workflow, and patch-pack prompt load and apply the protocol.

requirements.text: Regression tests prevent weakening closure semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Tests reject full post-implementation review, unlimited rounds, missing blocker bases, stronger-contract blockers, and disabled stop behavior.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Reviewed v1.2.0 workflow, archive prompts, patch-pack contract, and release baseline.
Authored complete documentation, machine contract, schema, validator, tests, and prompt integration.
Parsed generated JSON and Python ASTs and validated patch path scope without executing repository tests.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: unit, integration, oracle, pytest, compile, lint, build, and GitHub Actions gates
known_integration_risks: Prompt wording tests intentionally enforce closure semantics and may expose contradictory historical wording elsewhere.
The feature adds governance only; it must not change the existing full-review default before scope approval.
forbidden_deviations: Do not convert follow-up classes into merge blockers.
Do not restore unconstrained full review after correction.
Do not weaken the owner approval boundary or existing full initial review.
Do not change VERSION, create a release, merge, or modify external repositories.
